# Media Matters for America

> > A progressive research and information center dedicated to monitoring, analyzing, and correcting conservative misinformation in U.S. media.

Media Matters for America tracks media coverage across platforms including TikTok, Facebook, and traditional news outlets, with a focus on identifying false narratives, viral misinformation, and problematic content trends. The organization provides fact-checking, media analysis, and documentation of how misinformation spreads through social media platforms and entertainment channels.

## Key Topics

- TikTok viral trends
- Social media misinformation
- Know Your Meme documentation
- Viral video analysis
- Short-form video content
- Platform accountability (TikTok, Facebook)
- Meme culture and spread
- Content moderation
- ByteDance and TikTok Ltd.
- Cross-platform viral content
- Entertainment and politics intersection
- Mobile app ecosystems (iOS, Android)
- Live-streaming platforms
- User-generated content trends
